title: Mac native portability
objective: Make native compiler identity, sanitizer lifecycle witnesses, and dense-prime timing validation robust on real Apple systems without weakening required-native, sanitizer, absolute-performance, or legacy-relative gates.

oracles: Required-native execution across a lexical /var alias matches the compiled physical source identity.
Darwin sanitizer witnesses retain AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer while disabling only unsupported LeakSanitizer detection.
Dense-prime structural timing retains absolute and legacy-relative bounds under robust repeated sampling.
